fields.name: num_designs
fields.label: Backbone designs
fields.help: Backbones generated per run.

fields.name: diffusion_steps
fields.label: Diffusion steps
fields.help: Upstream's all-atom configuration uses 100.

fields.name: deterministic
fields.label: Deterministic
fields.help: Seeds every generator, so a repeated run reproduces the same designs.

fields.name: write_trajectory
fields.label: Save trajectories
fields.help: Writes the denoising trajectory beside each design. The files are large.

fields.name: enzyme_input_file
fields.label: Active-site structure
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A STRUCTURE CONTAINING THE ACTIVE SITE HERE

fields.name: enzyme_contig
fields.label: Contig map
fields.help: Comma-separated segments: a designed length (46, or a range 40-60), a residue taken from the input (A106-106), or 0 for a chain break. Separate chains with an underscore.

fields.name: enzyme_contig_atoms
fields.label: Motif atoms
fields.default:
A106: NE,CD,CZ
A166: OD1,CG
A169: NH2,CZ
A193: NE2,CD2,CE1
fields.help: One "residue: atoms" per line. Only these atoms are held; the rest of each side chain, and the backbone under it, are redesigned. This is what separates RFdiffusion2 from RFdiffusion, which can hold only whole residues.

fields.name: enzyme_ligand
fields.label: Ligands (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated PDB chemical component IDs to carry over from the input structure.

fields.name: enzyme_unindexed
fields.label: Let the model place the motif
fields.help: Guideposts: the active site is built at residue positions, and in an order, that the network chooses instead of the ones the contig names. Turning this off scaffolds the motif at exactly the contig's positions, as RFdiffusion does.

fields.name: enzyme_unindexed_positions
fields.label: Place only these residues (optional)
fields.help: Restricts the above to the residues listed, e.g. A106; every other motif residue stays at its contig position. Ignored when the model is not placing the motif.

fields.name: enzyme_partially_fixed_ligand
fields.label: Partially fixed ligand atoms (optional)
fields.help: One "ligand: atoms" per line, e.g. NAD: O7N,C7N,C3N. Those atoms are held in place and the rest of that ligand is diffused along with the protein.

fields.name: small_molecule_input_file
fields.label: Ligand structure
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A STRUCTURE CONTAINING THE LIGAND HERE

fields.name: small_molecule_ligand
fields.label: Ligand
fields.help: PDB chemical component ID of the ligand to build a pocket around.

fields.name: small_molecule_length
fields.label: Design length
fields.help: A single number, or a min-max range such as 140-150.

fields.name: small_molecule_use_rasa
fields.label: Condition on ligand burial
fields.help: Conditions the design on a target relative solvent-accessible surface area for the ligand.

fields.name: small_molecule_rasa
fields.label: Target relative SASA
fields.help: 0 buries the ligand completely; higher values leave more of it exposed.

fields.name: motif_input_file
fields.label: Motif source structure
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A STRUCTURE CONTAINING THE MOTIF HERE

fields.name: motif_contig
fields.label: Contig map
fields.help: Comma-separated segments, as for the enzyme task: designed lengths around residue ranges taken from the input.

fields.name: motif_length
fields.label: Total length (optional)
fields.help: Constrains the total sampled length, e.g. 100-120.

fields.name: motif_contig_atoms
fields.label: Atomized residues (optional)
fields.help: One "residue: atoms" per line. Residues listed here are held as loose atoms; the rest of the contig is held as whole backbone positions.

fields.name: motif_ligand
fields.label: Ligands (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated PDB chemical component IDs to carry over from the input structure.

fields.name: motif_unindexed
fields.label: Let the model place the motif
fields.help: Guideposts, as in the enzyme task: the motif lands where the network chooses rather than at the contig's positions.

fields.name: monomer_length
fields.label: Design length
fields.help: A single number, or a min-max range such as 140-150.

fields.name: contigs
fields.label: Contig map
fields.help: Passed to contigmap.contigs as written.

fields.name: contigs_input_file
fields.label: Input structure (optional)
fields.help: Required by any contig that references chains of a structure.

fields.name: contigs_ligand
fields.label: Ligands (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated PDB chemical component IDs.

fields.name: contigs_contig_atoms
fields.label: Atomized residues (optional)
fields.help: One "residue: atoms" per line.

fields.name: contigs_overrides
fields.label: Extra overrides (optional)
fields.help: One Hydra key=value per line, e.g. inference.conditions.radius_of_gyration_v2.active=True. Keys that name a file or directory on the server are refused.
